title: PHASEFORM script params schema
description: The sidecar file that describes the params one script reads: scripts/health-bar.js is described by scripts/health-bar.params.json. The file is itself a JSON Schema for the object `params`, restricted to the vocabulary below so that editors can build controls from it without running code. See docs/SPEC.md (Script params).

required.description: Keys that must have a value after defaults are applied. A missing one is a validation warning.

additionalProperties.description: false makes a key that no attached script's schema knows a validation warning (it catches typos). Default true.

enum.description: Allowed values; editors show a drop-down.

default.description: The value used when the scene gives none. The loader copies it into ctx.params.

title.description: Label for editors. Optional: editors fall back to the key.

format.description: A string holding #rrggbb. String params only.
